warnings: Elevation titles: the 3.50 sloped truss (left, 4 x 0.875) is TRUSS T2 and the 4.20 flat truss (right, 6 x 0.700) is TRUSS T1; T2's elevation is labelled 'T1' at its left end, T1's is labelled 'T2' at both ends — consistent with the plan (T1 on grid 1, T2 on rows A and B).

Each truss uses two tube sizes. steel_section is the chord section; the web/vertical section is kept in web_steel_section (no schema field for a second section on one member — reuse it rather than invent another spelling). Leader reading: T2 = 100x50 top chord, 75x38 bottom chord + posts; T1 = 100x50 both chords, 75x38 posts.
The panel chains are in the grid master (dimension_chains, views TRUSS T1/T2); the truss depths 0.599 / 0.483 are member dimensions and stay here.
Tube symbol printed as a slashed Ø before the size; read as rectangular hollow section (RHS), print kept in printed_as.

supports: อะเส 2C-150x50x20x2.3 (กริด 2, หลังอะเสระดับ +5.85)
